name: Yelo
note: Saudi car-rental brand (Al-Wefaq Company for Transportation Solutions); front sponsor at several clubs. Almajdouie Group's Majd Investment completed a 25% acquisition in February 2022 (claim yelo-majd-stake; the release names Nasser Al-Qahtani as Yelo's chairman). Who holds the rest of the company is not published, so it stays not rated.
